## Change / 改动

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. / 说明问题及改动后的行为。

## Compatibility / 兼容性

Explain save, collection, privacy/API payload and performance changes. / 说明存档、采集、隐私/API 数据及性能影响。

## Validation / 验证

Describe the checks actually performed and any in-game validation still needed. / 列出实际完成的检查及仍需在游戏内确认的事项。
